mapper.sql: k.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND k.status='PUBLISHED' AND k.code_review_status<>'REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs ref LEFT JOIN code_chunks current_chunk ON current_chunk.repo_id=ref.repo_id AND current_chunk.file_path=ref.file_path AND current_chunk.start_line=ref.start_line AND current_chunk.content_hash=ref.content_hash WHERE ref.card_id=k.id AND ref.revision=k.revision AND current_chunk.id IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id repository_id, r.current_snapshot_id snapshot_id, r.current_commit commit_sha, COUNT(c.id) total_chunks, COUNT(e.chunk_id) vectorized_chunks, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE e.chunk_id IS NULL) missing_chunks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_cards k WHERE ) knowledge_cards, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_cards k JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings ke ON ke.card_id=k.id AND ke.revision=k.revision WHERE ) vectorized_knowledge_cards, COALESCE( MAX(e.model), (SELECT vm.model FROM vector_model_activation va JOIN vector_model_configs vm ON vm.id=va.active_config_id WHERE va.singleton_id=1) ) vector_model, COALESCE( MAX(e.dimension), (SELECT vm.dimension FROM vector_model_activation va JOIN vector_model_configs vm ON vm.id=va.active_config_id WHERE va.singleton_id=1) ) dimension, GREATEST( MAX(e.created_at), (SELECT MAX(ke.created_at) FROM knowledge_card_embeddings ke WHERE ke.repo_id=r.id) ) updated_at FROM repositories r LEFT JOIN code_chunks c ON c.repo_id=r.id AND c.snapshot_id=r.current_snapshot_id LEFT JOIN chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id=c.id WHERE r.id=#{repositoryId} GROUP BY r.id,r.current_snapshot_id,r.current_commit

SELECT k.id,k.title,k.card_type,k.revision, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(k.content,E'\\s+',' ','g'),260) content_excerpt, ke.content_hash,ke.model vector_model, CASE WHEN ke.card_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 64 END dimension, ke.created_at vectorized_at, CASE WHEN ke.card_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'EMBEDDED' END vector_status FROM knowledge_cards k LEFT JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings ke ON ke.card_id=k.id AND ke.revision=k.revision WHERE
AND( POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(k.title))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(k.content))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(ARRAY_TO_STRING(k.tags,' ')))>0 )
AND ke.card_id IS NOT NULL AND ke.card_id IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN ke.card_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,k.updated_at DESC,k.id
